name: Motisons Jewellers Limited
summary: Motisons Jewellers Ltd. is an Indian company that makes and retails jewelry, including bangles, necklaces, earrings, pendants, rings, chains and mangalsutras, in gold, diamonds, kundan, pearls, silver, platinum and gemstones. It also sells gold and silver coins, utensils and decorative items, and offers an online store alongside its physical shops.
